correctness.rationale: For uniform iid n-coupon draws, B in {2,...,n+1}. For B=b<=n, exactly b-1 distinct coupons seen; from time b complete coverage adds independent geometric waits G_k for k=b-1..n-1. Therefore E[T|B=b]=b+nH_(n-b+1), while the boundary B=n+1 means T=n. Common coupled geometric G_k yield nonincreasing first-order stochastic order with strict comparisons, and K=first initial run of G_k=1 yields Cov(B,T)=-sum_{j=2}^n S_{n,j}sum_{k<j}k/(n-k)<0, including n=2 negative 1/2. Birthday survival bound leads B/sqrt n=>Rayleigh R; quadratic-regression asymptotic m(B)-nH_n=1-B²/(2n)+o_L²(1), giving Cov/sqrt n->-sqrt(pi/8) and n*Corr->-sqrt(3/[2pi(4-pi)]) via coupon-collector variance pi²n²/6. Independent exact rational prefix enumeration n=2..5 checked conditional laws and covariance, with n=3 -8/9, n=4 -37/32 and n=5 -844/625; nonasymptotic proof not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Exact asymptotic L² approximation relies on uniform tail/moment bound and correct exception B=n+1; independent prefix enumeration does not certify the infinity limit.
